chunk_findings.detail: The replacement still disagrees with claim/wait. It says a named `claim <id>` “grants a specific item whatever the cap says, so `wait --item <id>` … returns at once,” and in the next sentence calls the cap “a limit on how much starts at once.” Given the bug’s own input (9 in flight, limit 3, item otherwise ready), `claim` starts a 10th item, so the cap is not a start limit; given an unmet dependency, `wait --item <id>` does not return at once. An agent still cannot tell whether the cap is a real stop, which is Ba7c5816744. The new test only checks three substrings and stays green on this wording.
